description: Runs the 401k.loans true-cost calculator: payment per paycheck and number of payments, total repaid and interest, pre-tax pay needed per payment, tax later on the interest, the 401(k) balance at payoff with and without the loan (growth gap) and that gap at 65, the legal and usual plan borrowing limits, and, if you might leave the job, the balance owed then plus the tax and 10% additional tax if it is not repaid or rolled over.

assumed_return_pct.description: Annual return you assume the 401(k) would earn, in percent (-20 to 20). An assumption, not a forecast. Default 6.

federal_bracket_pct.description: 2026 federal income tax bracket in percent (Rev. Proc. 2025-32): 10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35 or 37.

leave_job_after_months.description: Model leaving the job after this many months (0 = do not model it). Default 24, as on the page.

loan_amount.description: Amount to borrow in dollars, e.g. 15000.

lost_match_per_paycheck.description: Employer match you would lose with them, dollars per paycheck. Default 0.

paused_contribution_per_paycheck.description: Your own 401(k) contributions you would stop while repaying, dollars per paycheck. Default 0.

pay_frequency.description: How often you are paid (one loan payment per paycheck). Default biweekly.

plan_rate_pct.description: Plan loan interest rate in percent, 0 to 20. Default: the prime rate plus 1 point, as an example; the real rate is on your plan's loan paperwork.

state_tax_pct.description: State income tax rate in percent, 0 to 15. Default 0.

years.description: Years to repay: 1 to 5, or 10 or 15 for a loan to buy your main home. Default 5.

name: calculate_401k_loan_cost
title: True cost of a 401(k) loan
